• Brand introduction: 

Embark on a new adventure with Mar Soreli through the timeless elegance of Friulane shoes, the epitome of traditional and versatile handcrafted Italian slippers. The captivating story behind Friulane shoes, originating in Carnia, Friuli, over a century ago, is truly remarkable and worthy of your attention. It unfolds as a tale of love, dedication, and creativity; where resourceful mothers in the countryside poured their hearts into crafting these slippers, providing their daughters with a touch of festivity in place of the everyday wood clogs that most families relied on. It's a testament to the heritage and ingenuity that defines our Friulane collections, offering more than just shoes; they represent a lifestyle choice that intertwines elegance, comfort, and responsibility.


• Product description:

Italian handmade velvet flats, and ballet flats, in unique colors and color combinations. Ideal for any event or day-to-day use.

 
• USP (Unique Selling Point):

Handmade in Italy with sustainability in mind. 

 
• Payment terms: 

Commission paid automatically.
payout_period: After 30 days to allow for returns.

Marsoreli Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

1. Overview

By joining the Marsoreli Affiliate Program (“Program”), you agree to the following terms. These terms apply to all affiliates (“you”) who promote Marsoreli (“we” or “the brand”). Participation is subject to approval and continued compliance.

2. Affiliate Approval

All affiliates must apply for review.
We reserve the right to approve or reject any application for reasons including but not limited to:

  • Promotional methods used

  • Brand alignment

  • Past behavior or reputation

  • Compliance with these terms

We may request additional information before final approval.

3. Commission Structure

  • Affiliates earn 10% commission on verified sales made through their referral links or custom discount codes.

  • Only legitimate, completed orders qualify.

  • Orders that are canceled, refunded, or fraudulent will not earn commission.

  • Commission is calculated on the subtotal (excluding taxes, shipping, and discounts).

4. Payment Terms

  • Commissions are paid monthly via PayPal once a minimum payout of $50 is reached.

  • Affiliates must ensure payment details are accurate and up to date.

  • Any payment processor fees are the affiliate’s responsibility.

  • Orders under dispute or refunded will not be paid out.

5. Prohibited Practices

Affiliates must comply with all advertising laws and FTC disclosure requirements. Affiliates may not engage in the following:

  • Creating or promoting misleading claims.

  • Using spam tactics or unsolicited emails.

  • Copying Marsoreli’s trademarks, logo, or branding in domain names or URLs.

  • Sharing affiliate links or discount codes on Marsoreli’s official social media pages.

  • Impersonating Marsoreli or its team.

6. Coupon & Code Policy

Marsoreli provides custom codes for genuine content promotion only. Affiliates may not:

  • Post or distribute codes on coupon, cashback, or deal websites (e.g., Honey, RetailMeNot, CouponBirds).

  • Share or repost codes in Facebook groups, Reddit, or other promo forums.

  • Allow third parties to scrape or reuse their codes online.

Violation of this policy will result in suspension or termination.

7. PPC & Paid Ads Policy

Affiliates are not permitted to:

  • Bid on “Marsoreli” or any brand-related keywords.

  • Use variations or misspellings of our brand in ad copy, headlines, or URLs.

  • Run paid search or display campaigns linking directly to Marsoreli.com.

Any breach will lead to immediate removal from the program.

8. Tracking & Cookies

  • We use cookies to track referrals for 30 days from the first click.

  • If a user clears cookies or disables tracking, sales cannot be credited.

  • Commissions are awarded only for orders placed within the active cookie window.

9. Termination

We reserve the right to remove any affiliate at any time for:

  • Violating program policies

  • Fraudulent or unethical behavior

  • Coupon or PPC violations

  • Misuse of brand assets or impersonation

Affiliates may also terminate participation at any time by emailing alec@marsoreli.com.

10. Limitation of Liability

Marsoreli is not responsible for:

  • Loss of income or data

  • Delays in payment caused by third-party services

  • Technical tracking issues beyond our control

Participation in the program is at your own risk.
